title: Give every open PR in claude-settings and q_max one next act and an owner
why: Owner, 12:17 CST Nov 7: PRs sit idle because sessions lost track. A future check lands no work; the backlog needs a decision per PR now.
note: Owner 348 a (13:12 CST): the ten held PRs are released. Lane held-prs-release (session_013NEJL3PuiQWCxTykFvcmMc) takes 8; #1147 and #1177 stay with cs-revive-unfinished. q_max #1070 closes (coordinator's pick: D-570 rules a spent one-act grant out of D-542; the ruling text stays in commit 8f9ffd7bb). Next acts: next batch, fix lane, close as replaced or dropped (closes route to a session on the owner's computer under the claude-settings standing grant), or an owner question on the page. Done: zero open PRs without a next act and an owner. Review state and cause per PR are unknown until read; do not guess them. Inventory at 12:28 CST: 68 + 25 open, none landed. Revive lanes started 12:40 CST by the coordinator: cs-revive-ready (session_013NEJL2ZbrUt2zRpHHNsMec), cs-revive-unfinished (session_013NEJL4E3uV2CMHXZSfo6xv), qmax-revive-idle (session_013NEJL2DBWxESS5TMW5cCFW). Owner items 333-335 ask keep, change or close for #1106, #1008, #1247. #1034 (shivpedia plan) needs no item: it waits on step shivpedia-count (until 2026-11-20), home step craft-book. The coordinator runs this step. PRs the audit did not class (q_max #1011, #1038, dependabot #884, #1013, and the rest) go to runners 8 and 9 to name a next act. #1008 (owner 334 b): all 7 'filed not started' rows already have steps (F36, F58: tci-9-live-protection; F37: c91, c196; F100: page-parked-actions, done; F107: page-ask-box, done; F155: ci-hygiene-refresh; F158: tci-5-platform-tested). The 6 'unknown' rows (F39, F82, F84, F93, F251, F252) are unrecoverable session claims; one note in triage's outbox. #1008 may close. Coordinator scan 21:35 CST Nov 7, unverified by a tool: (1) the ledger fix is built and idle: #1419, #1561, #1569 each have a PASS record on the live head; runner 8 puts them in batch 62 with #1347. (2) 215 PRs carry a PASS record on the live head (142 under 6 h old); 27 with no record and older than 24 h (#1315-#1386, the #1371 class); runner 8 verifies with merge --reviewed --json. (3) 26 merges in 45 h, 1-5 lanes per batch. (4) Lane cs-revive-ready compared lists and did not read PR state, so it missed #1371. (5) About 306 completed lanes unarchived, because the archive sweep was dead in the cloud until #1634; add a third gold-0 number: completed lanes not archived after one batch cycle. (6) Runner 9 classifies child-repo PRs older than 24 h (home 10, degen 6, q_max 4, banchi 3, mailaudit 2, joyous 1). Owner ruling on item 384, typed in the coordinator chat at 21:42 CST Nov 7 and relayed by the coordinator: "ill allow holding off on spawning new lanes but u shd still be able to spawn the lanes that will result in these fixes landing". So new lanes wait, and the lanes that make the idle-PR, archive and drain fixes land still start.
